body.label: Target
body.html: Up to two enemies within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, push each target 1 unit. Choose one hit target to take 1 weapon Damage.

surges.html: An adjacent willing ally may move 1 unit into a vacated space.
One hit target is Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Combo - Breaker
rider.html: If at least one target ends farther from you, enter Pike Stance: your first Prowess Reaction against an approaching enemy before your next turn gains 1 Surge.
